name: BalancedChart.linear_support_transform
statement: theorem linear_support_transform {K : Type} [CommRing K] (x a l w u0 inverse : K) (hu : x+u0=0) (hchart : (x-a)*w=l) (hi : (a+u0)*inverse=1) : w+l*inverse=0

name: BalancedChart.balanced_infinity_images
statement: theorem balanced_infinity_images {H : Type} [IntModule H] (finite qplus qminus : H) (m n : Int) (hminus : qminus = -qplus) : finite+(n-1) • qplus+(1-m-n) • qminus = finite+(2*n+m-2) • qplus
